name: web-payment-installments-modal-over-dimmed-checkout
title: Installment Payment Modal
whatItIs: A white centered modal from a payment provider over a dimmed checkout: pink logo tag and total, collapsible delivery address, a split-in-4 installment timeline with pie-icons, a card row with Change, and a black Confirm to Pay button.
whatItMeans: The dimmed background isolates the decision, and the black pill button makes the final commitment unmistakable.
techniques: Dark scrim behind a bright modal for focus
Pie-progress icons to show installments filling up
Stacked collapsible rows to manage density
Black pill for the final confirm to differ from the app's lime CTA
Third-party brand color (pink tag) as a trust marker

vocabulary.definition: A translucent dark layer that dims the page behind a modal.
A row showing each payment date and amount.
A small circle filled by quarters to show progress.
